# The Martin Luther King, Jr. Research and Education Institute

> > Digital archive of Martin Luther King, Jr.'s papers, correspondence, and civil rights movement documentation from Stanford University

The King Institute at Stanford University houses comprehensive primary source materials documenting Dr. King's life, the Montgomery Bus Boycott, the civil rights movement, and his relationships with key figures like Ralph Abernathy, Bayard Rustin, and Harry Belafonte. The collection includes correspondence, speeches, and scholarly resources spanning from King's youth through his leadership of the Montgomery Improvement Association and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Martin Luther King, Jr.
- Montgomery Bus Boycott
- Montgomery Improvement Association
- Civil Rights Movement
- Nonviolent resistance
- Dexter Avenue Baptist Church
- Ralph Abernathy
- Bayard Rustin
- NAACP
- Desegregation
- Alabama voting rights
- Highlander Folk School
- Nashville sit-ins
- Boston University
- Crozer Theological Seminary

## Montgomery Bus Boycott & Civil Rights Leadership (1956-1960)

- [To the Commissioners of the City of Montgomery](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/commissioners-city-montgomery): 1956 resolution to Montgomery commissioners on bus segregation
- [To Bayard Rustin](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/bayard-rustin-2): 1956 letter to Bayard Rustin on Montgomery boycott organizing
- [To J. H. Jackson](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/j-h-jackson-1): 1956 gratitude letter to J.H. Jackson during Montgomery Bus Boycott
- [To Warren Olney III](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/warren-olney-iii-1): 1956 letter to DOJ about Alabama voting rights discrimination
- [To John Malcolm Patterson](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/john-malcolm-patterson-0): 1959 letter to Alabama governor about racial violence
- [Alabama NAACP fined $10,000; ordered to release records](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/alabama-naacp-fined-10000-ordered-release-records): 1956 court ruling against Alabama NAACP by Judge Jones
- [To Kelly Miller Smith](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/kelly-miller-smith-1): 1960 letter supporting Nashville sit-in movement protests

## Civil Rights Network & Organizing Correspondence

- [To Septima Poinsette Clark](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/septima-poinsette-clark-0): 1956 letter to Septima Clark re: Highlander Folk School workshop
- [To Clarence L. Jordan](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/clarence-l-jordan): 1957 letter supporting Koinonia Farm interracial community
- [To George Lawrence](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/george-lawrence-0): 1956 letter about In Friendship fundraising for MIA
- [To A. A. Banks, Jr.](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/banks-jr-0): 1957 letter to Detroit church about bombing fundraising support
- [To Harry Belafonte](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/harry-belafonte-0): 1959 thank-you letter to Harry Belafonte post-India trip

## Ministry & Professional Correspondence

- [To Samuel D. Proctor](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/samuel-d-proctor): Letter to Samuel Proctor about Dexter Church lecture series
- [To Ross Allen Weston](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/ross-allen-weston): 1956 letter to Unitarian Fellowship re: social justice award
- [To Marie F. Rodell](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/marie-f-rodell-0): 1957 letter to literary agent about Harper & Brothers contract

## Reference & Encyclopedia

- [King Encyclopedia: T](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-resources/king-encyclopedia/t): Encyclopedia entries for letter T: Taylor, Thomas, Thurman, etc.

## Optional

- [To Alberta Williams King](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/alberta-williams-king-3): 1944 youth letter to mother Alberta King from Connecticut
- [To Hugh Watt](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/hugh-watt): PhD application letter to University of Edinburgh from Crozer
- [To Charles E. Batten](https://kinginstitute.stanford.edu/king-papers/documents/charles-e-batten-6): 1952 transcript request to Crozer for Boston University studies
